$comment: Task 8p: where kino.qr.scan may open the scanner, shared by the app (ScreenQrOriginTest.kitParityWithTheSharedOriginCases, through PluginQrScanner.mayScanFrom) and the kit (test/qr-origin.test.mjs, through qrScanOriginAllowed). Each case is a call as the app's PluginCall sees it: function (the export running), screen (a plugin screen's call: a root screen, a screen-mode panel or a contributed tab in screen mode), press (that screen event follows the person's own tap or submit, never an open, a timer tick, a load-more or a change), tick (a screen timer's tick), interactive and personStarted (default true; false for a background or unattended call such as a panel's refreshMs). Absent booleans are false, except interactive and personStarted. allowed: whether the scanner may open.

cases.name: a settings action in Ajustes (also: one from the settings node inside a screen, which runs as the Ajustes action does)
a legacy panel's press (also: a contributed legacy tab's press)
a root screen's tap (also: a root screen's submit)
a screen-mode panel's press (also: a contributed tab's press in screen mode)
a screen's open event (also: a screen's load-more; a screen's change)
a tick is never a press
a screen-mode panel's load-more (also: a screen-mode panel's change)
a screenEvent outside a screen session
